items.title: EpiEvolve: Self-Evolving Agents for Streaming Pandemic Forecasting under Regime Shifts
items.title_zh: EpiEvolve：机制切换下流式疫情预测的自进化智能体
items.summary: EpiEvolve wraps a fixed-weight LLM forecaster with hierarchical episodic memory, reflection on delayed labels and regime-aware retrieval for streaming weekly COVID-19 hospitalization forecasts. It reports 0.629 average accuracy versus 0.561 for the static backbone and cuts recovery lag after regime shifts from five weeks to two.

items.title: Trust, but Don't Verify: Epistemic Blind Spots in LLM Source Evaluation
items.title_zh: 信任但不验证：LLM 信息源评估中的认知盲区
items.summary: The paper shows models can detect fabricated statistics in isolation but do not recruit that capability during multi-source synthesis, producing similar numeric estimates whether statistics are fabricated or valid. Source influence follows a methodology-register gate rather than numeric validity, a dissociation that replicates across six models from four families and three professional domains; prompting mitigations, even an oracle checklist, produce blanket skepticism rather than selective discernment.

items.title: Agentic Monte Carlo: Simulating Reinforcement Learning for Black-Box Agents
items.title_zh: Agentic Monte Carlo：为黑盒 Agent 模拟强化学习
items.summary: Agentic Monte Carlo exploits the equivalence between reinforcement learning and Bayesian inference to sample from an optimal policy for black-box LLM agents, using Sequential Monte Carlo with a learned value function to steer the agent while leaving the underlying model unchanged. On three AgentGym environments it beats prompting baselines and outperforms GRPO as test-time compute scales, with code released.

items.title: Executable Schema Contracts: From Automatic Ingestion to Multi-Source Retrieval
items.title_zh: 可执行 Schema 契约：从自动摄取到多源检索
items.summary: The system discovers an executable schema from raw multi-source data and uses it as a shared contract for knowledge graph construction and query-time retrieval, with deterministic structural analysis inferring identity keys, foreign keys and source hierarchy. The schema then conditions a multi-tool agent routing retrieval across structured lookup, graph traversal and vector search, improving over retrieval-only and decomposition-based baselines on four QA benchmarks.

items.title: ReasoningFlow: Discourse Structures for Understanding LLM Reasoning Traces
items.title_zh: ReasoningFlow：理解 LLM 推理轨迹的话语结构
items.summary: ReasoningFlow captures the discourse structure of reasoning traces as fine-grained directed acyclic graphs, validated on 31 manually annotated traces and scaled to 1,260 traces (247.7k steps) across three tasks and five models. The analysis finds structurally similar traces across models, surfaces fine-grained behaviors useful for monitoring, and reports that most erroneous steps are not used to derive final answers while causal dependencies do not mirror language-level discourse.

items.title: LLM-Guided ANN Index Optimization for Human-Object Interaction Retrieval
items.title_zh: LLM 引导的 ANN 索引优化，用于人-物交互检索
items.summary: A phase-aware LLM agent conditions each hyperparameter proposal on its full optimization history for ANN index tuning. On HICO-DET with Intel VDMS it beats Optuna TPE by 33.3% and VDTuner by 34.2% under the SIEVE throughput metric.

items.title: LoRi: Low-Rank Distillation for Implicit Reasoning
items.title_zh: LoRi：面向隐式推理的低秩蒸馏
items.summary: Observing that hidden-state reasoning trajectories exhibit low-rank structure, the authors propose a low-rank distillation framework that aligns teacher and student trajectories in a shared low-rank tensor subspace using first- and second-order statistics. Across LLaMA and Qwen models at different scales it improves mathematical reasoning, approaching explicit chain-of-thought accuracy and outperforming prior implicit-CoT distillation methods.

items.title: Localizing Prompt Ambiguity in Large Language Models with Probe-Targeted Attribution
items.title_zh: 利用探针靶向归因定位大语言模型中的提示歧义
items.summary: PRIG is a gradient attribution method that trains a linear probe to separate clear from ambiguous prompts and attributes the probe score to token positions. It reaches 0.840 AUROC on a synthetic benchmark and 0.891 on a human-written gold set while outperforming GPT-5.4 on sentence-level ambiguity identification.

items.title: BRepCLIP: Contrastive Multimodal Pretraining on BRep Primitives for CAD Understanding
items.title_zh: BRepCLIP：面向 CAD 理解的 BRep 基元对比多模态预训练
items.summary: BRepCLIP aligns boundary-representation CAD geometry with CLIP text and image embeddings through contrastive pretraining. It improves Top-1 retrieval over OpenShape by 40.4%, 22.0% and 23.9% on the ABC, CADParser and Automate benchmarks.

items.title: coreyhaines31/makerskills
items.title_zh: coreyhaines31/makerskills：面向个人效能的 AI Agent 技能集
items.summary: A Python collection of AI agent skills for decisions, research, a second brain, content rotation and scenario modeling, designed to work with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.

items.title: Introducing new capabilities to GPT-Rosalind
items.title_zh: 为 GPT-Rosalind 引入新能力
items.summary: OpenAI introduced new capabilities to GPT-Rosalind, which the company says advances life-sciences research through enhanced biological reasoning, medicinal chemistry expertise, genomics analysis and experimental workflow capabilities.

items.title: Tencent reportedly developing WeChat AI agent, makes it a top priority
items.title_zh: 腾讯据报开发微信 AI 智能体，并将其列为最高优先级
items.summary: Tencent is advancing plans to launch an embedded AI agent in WeChat and is testing a prototype, according to people familiar with the matter.
